Cookie Clicker: The Grandmas Are Not Okay

Regret: 45% (0% for me, 119% for my mouse)

You click a cookie. You get a cookie. You click it again. That's the game. Then you buy a grandma to bake for you, then a farm, then a portal to another dimension, and suddenly the grandmas have turned into a flesh-eating hive mind. Don't ask. I have 156 hours in a game where the main mechanic is clicking, and I regret nothing. My mouse regrets everything.

I both loved and hated this game. It is a huge time sink, the mods for it are pretty good, if you are achievement hunting they are quite helpful and at some point in the late game things just get slower, progression becomes tedious and quite boring. With all prestige upgrades there wasn't too much to look forward to. I played with a mod that adds more heavenly upgrades from then on and at that moment the fun with the game came back. Game was fun, a bit tedious, some aspects made me lose my mind, like the garden was a pain and a half for me without mods, so was the investment mini-game, but those two are probably just not my taste and would be more appealing to someone else. What else do you want to read, it's Cookie Clicker, you know it is good, you know it is fun. Careful not to get sucked in.
Good game, and done with the game, I have all the achievements

Really enjoyed this game.

What I like the most is that Cookie Clicker basically lets you enjoy it in your own way. I started completely legit, played actively, went AFK for a few days, learned the mechanics, and progressed normally.

After a while though, it started getting a bit boring because some parts are just pure waiting. So I installed a Better Autoclicker workshop mod that clicks the main cookie and Golden Cookies automatically. That immediately made the game much more fun for me because I could focus on upgrades, ascensions, minigames and progression instead of manually clicking nonstop.
